assertions: All 4 built-in presets (default, developer, minimal, paranoid) successfully apply to Config without error
Restricted paths policy denies read_file, write_file, edit_file, list_dir, and exec attempts against forbidden paths
Network egress policy blocks web_search, web_fetch, browser_action, and shell network commands when disabled
Destructive tool policy enforces HITL approval tickets for write_file, edit_file, and exec when required, and permits execution upon resolution
Developer preset allows direct execution of destructive tools without tickets
Explicit unsupported or invalid blueprint settings fail closed atomically without mutating target configuration
